# Fetch Venmo transactions received in date range around dinner
pw = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
ven_access = apis.venmo.login(username='kri-powe@gmail.com', password={c['account_name']:c['password'] for c in pw}['venmo'])['access_token']
phone_dt = apis.phone.get_current_date_and_time()
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
base_date = datetime.strptime(phone_dt['date'], '%A, %B %d, %Y').date()
yesterday = base_date - timedelta(days=1)
today = base_date
min_created_at = yesterday.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
max_created_at = (today).strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
print('range', min_created_at, max_created_at)

txs=[]
page=0
while True:
    res = apis.venmo.show_transactions(access_token=ven_access, direction='received', min_created_at=min_created_at, max_created_at=max_created_at, page_index=page, page_limit=20)
    print('page', page, 'count', len(res))
    if not res:
        break
    txs.extend(res)
    page += 1
print('total received txs', len(txs))
# print a sample first 30
